note: Work: 16. Employment Act (Act No 2/2008), in the English translation the Ministry of Economic Development and Trade published until its file went (2026-11-03), and the Labour Relations Authority's since: minors under sixteen shall not be employed except in training linked to their education, and minors under sixteen in the family's own line of work are exempt (s. 6); a minor may work only with the guardian's consent, not in school hours or after 11 p.m. (ss. 8, 9): not held. The Labour Relations Authority's consolidated translation to 21 September 2022 wasn't compared until 2026-11-03, when it replaced the ministry's; its ss. 6 to 9 give the same ages and conditions. Performers: barred, the reading being that s. 6 has no exception for performers. Majority: null; the Act says a child is under eighteen under Law No 9/91 (rights of the child), which isn't the age of majority in law, and mvlaw.gov.mv's legislation API answers 'Unauthenticated' to this client (2026-10-31). Service: null; the Armed Forces Act (Law No 1/2008) wasn't read. Re-read on 2026-11-03: Ministry of Economic Development and Trade (Maldives): Employment Act, Act No 2/2008 (English translation) (https://trade.gov.mv/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/employment-act-2-2008-en.pdf) answered 404 Not Found on 2026-11-03, and the ministry's site gave no new address for it; it was read at https://lra.gov.mv/employment-act-2-2008-english instead.

sources.title: Labour Relations Authority (Maldives): Employment Act, Law No 2/2008, unofficial English translation consolidated with amendments to 21 September 2022
sources.said: 6. Minors under the age of sixteen years shall not be employed except for training associated with their education or deportment. Minors under the age of 16 years who participate in the family's line of work on their own accord shall be exempted from this principle. … A child shall be deemed to be under 18 (eighteen) years of age as provided for in Law No 9/91 (The Law on the Protection of the Rights of the Child).
